meetai.name: MeetAI
meetai.challenge: An app where you create AI agents, schedule meetings with them and join them on a video call. The agent answers out loud; afterwards the app produces the recording, the transcript, a summary and a chat to ask questions about the meeting.
meetai.built: A meeting lifecycle driven by signed webhooks: upcoming, active, processing, completed. Summary generated as a background job, in retryable steps (Inngest). Every request scoped to the user on the server, free-plan limits checked before the write. Subscription handled with Polar, in test mode.

hms.name: Ophtachusm
hms.challenge: An app to run the daily work of an ophthalmology department: patient files, medical records, eye images, appointments and statistics. New accounts wait for an administrator's approval before they can see any data.
hms.built: Built for the ophthalmology department of a hospital in Agadir and used by its team for several months. An appointment calendar that follows how the department works: consultation, specialty, surgery and professor, validated by type. Eye images uploaded and annotated by eye, type and description. Statistics computed on the server: twelve months and month-over-month change.

yoga-booking.name: Yoga booking
yoga-booking.challenge: A booking platform for a yoga studio. Participants browse sessions, book a place or join the waiting list, and cancel before each session's deadline. The studio runs everything from a custom admin panel: sessions, categories, instructors, participants, bookings and a downloadable menu document.
yoga-booking.built: A booking checked on the server in a single transaction: published session, remaining places, then confirmation or waiting list. Automatic waiting list: when a place frees up, the first person in line is confirmed, and a database constraint prevents duplicates. Admin rights checked against the database on every action, not only in the interface. Bilingual from the data model: every session, category and instructor exists in French and English.

cote-royale.name: Côte Royale
cote-royale.challenge: A showcase site for an imaginary perfume brand, built to push animation. Scrolling is smooth, letters light up as you scroll and pages blend into one another. Fragrances and text are managed from Prismic, with no code changes.
cote-royale.built: Scroll-driven animation: GSAP and ScrollTrigger, smooth scrolling with Lenis, and native page transitions that keep the navigation still. Reusable animation components, with a simplified version for people who reduce motion. Content driven by Prismic: a home page built from six blocks, fragrance pages generated ahead of time and refreshed when an editor publishes. Video loaded only when it nears the screen, to keep the first load light.
